description: Source code for the 'installd' daemon in Android, responsible for installation and management of app data, including directory setup, SELinux integration, and service startup.

methods.name: get_property
methods.description: Retrieves a system property value given a key, with a default fallback.

methods.name: calculate_oat_file_path
methods.description: Calculates the file path for the OAT file based on directory, APK path, and instruction set.

methods.name: calculate_odex_file_path
methods.description: Calculates the file path for the odex file based on APK path and instruction set.

methods.name: create_cache_path
methods.description: Creates a cache directory path based on source and instruction set.

methods.name: force_compile_without_image
methods.description: Indicates whether to force compilation without image; always returns false.

methods.name: initialize_globals
methods.description: Initializes global variables from data and root directories.

methods.name: initialize_directories
methods.description: Sets up necessary directories, handles filesystem layout upgrades, and manages SELinux and keychain directories.

methods.name: log_callback
methods.description: SELinux logging callback function that maps SELinux log types to Android log priorities.

methods.name: installd_main
methods.description: Main function for the installd daemon; initializes environment, directories, SELinux, starts the native service, and joins the thread pool.
